d:
Massive unexplained ancient structures carved into stone, entire lost ancient cities vanishing overnight, and clues pointing toward legendary treasure. Plunge into the most gripping investigations of Unexplained and Unexplored as treasure hunters and explorers uncover forgotten history and secrets of ancient civilizations that defy logic. Relive the strangest discoveries, remote expeditions, and unanswered questions from across the world.
Watch Unexplained and Unexplored Season 1 Episodes 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 & 7 on Discovery Channel India.
